<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="10"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="24"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>

  <g opacity="0.06" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <circle cx="326" cy="91" r="86"/>
    <circle cx="351" cy="164" r="54"/>
    <polygon points="244,0 390,0 390,122 320,102"/>
    <polygon points="0,676 109,596 174,844 0,844"/>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0.05" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2">
    <circle cx="322" cy="92" r="116"/>
    <circle cx="322" cy="92" r="146"/>
    <line x1="237" y1="12" x2="382" y2="157"/>
    <line x1="266" y1="0" x2="390" y2="124"/>
    <polygon points="19,720 91,647 165,720 91,793"/>
    <line x1="10" y1="755" x2="153" y2="612"/>
    <line x1="34" y1="797" x2="180" y2="651"/>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0.13" fill="#AA9EB7" filter="url(#soft)">
    <ellipse cx="351" cy="258" rx="55" ry="76"/>
    <ellipse cx="43" cy="612" rx="42" ry="91"/>
  </g>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif">
    <text x="20" y="27" font-size="14" font-weight="500">9:41</text>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <line x1="319" y1="26" x2="319" y2="22"/>
    <line x1="324" y1="26" x2="324" y2="19"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="26" x2="329" y2="16"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="26" x2="334" y2="13"/>
    <path d="M345 20 C350 15 357 15 362 20"/>
    <path d="M348 23 C351 20 356 20 359 23"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="353.5" cy="26" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="370" y="16" width="18" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="372" y="18" width="13" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="388.5" y="19.5" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <polyline points="29,78 21,86 29,94"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="86" x2="42" y2="86"/>
  </g>
  <text x="58" y="92" font-family="Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Transfer</text>
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none">
    <circle cx="360" cy="86" r="11"/>
    <line x1="360" y1="82" x2="360" y2="90"/>
    <circle cx="360" cy="78.5" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
  </g>

  <text x="24" y="137" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#79767D">MOVE MONEY</text>

  <!-- from card shadow -->
  <rect x="22" y="151" width="346" height="104" rx="22" fill="#212121" opacity="0.45" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="147" width="346" height="104" rx="22" fill="#212121" stroke="#363339" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="43" y="172" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#79767D">FROM</text>
    <circle cx="52" cy="207" r="22" fill="#AA9EB7"/>
    <text x="52" y="212" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">A</text>
    <rect x="86" y="193" width="109" height="11" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
    <rect x="86" y="211" width="72" height="7" rx="3" fill="#79767D" opacity="0.75"/>
    <rect x="281" y="191" width="61" height="19" rx="9" fill="#363339"/>
    <text x="311" y="205" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF">••••</text>
    <line x1="43" y1="232" x2="346" y2="232" stroke="#363339"/>
    <text x="43" y="245" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#79767D">AVAILABLE</text>
    <rect x="112" y="238" width="84" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- connector -->
  <g>
    <line x1="195" y1="251" x2="195" y2="276" stroke="#79767D" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="264" r="13" fill="#000000" stroke="#363339"/>
    <polyline points="190,264 195,269 200,264" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- recipient card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="277" width="346" height="104" rx="22" fill="#212121" stroke="#363339" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="43" y="302" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#79767D">TO</text>
    <circle cx="52" cy="337" r="22" fill="#FF5113"/>
    <text x="52" y="342" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">+</text>
    <rect x="86" y="322" width="119" height="11" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
    <rect x="86" y="341" width="91" height="7" rx="3" fill="#79767D" opacity="0.75"/>
    <rect x="282" y="321" width="60" height="19" rx="9" fill="#363339"/>
    <text x="312" y="335" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF">••••</text>
    <line x1="43" y1="358" x2="346" y2="358" stroke="#363339"/>

    <rect x="117" y="365" width="93" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- amount field -->
  <text x="24" y="421" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#79767D">AMOUNT</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="435" width="346" height="74" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="45" y="481" font-family="Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">••••••</text>
    <rect x="277" y="457" width="67" height="29" rx="14" fill="#EDFC74"/>
    <text x="310" y="477" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">•••</text>
  </g>

  <!-- note field, intentionally redacted -->
  <text x="24" y="551" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#79767D">NOTE</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="565" width="346" height="54" rx="16" fill="#212121" stroke="#363339"/>
    <rect x="44" y="588" width="181" height="9" rx="4" fill="#79767D" opacity="0.55"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="592" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#79767D"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="592" x2="344" y2="592" stroke="#79767D"/>
  </g>

  <!-- transfer action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="643" width="346" height="54" rx="27" fill="#FF5113"/>
    <text x="195" y="677" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
    <polyline points="263,670 269,676 263,682" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="709" width="346" height="42" rx="21" fill="none" stroke="#363339"/>
    <text x="195" y="735" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">Cancel</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation surface -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" rx="28" fill="#212121" opacity="0.94"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#363339"/>
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- chat -->
    <rect x="35" y="785" width="24" height="17" rx="6"/>
    <polygon points="41,802 41,808 47,802" fill="#212121"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="793" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="49" cy="793" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="55" cy="793" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <!-- card -->
    <rect x="117" y="786" width="27" height="19" rx="4"/>
    <line x1="119" y1="792" x2="142" y2="792"/>
    <line x1="122" y1="800" x2="130" y2="800"/>

    <polygon points="190,792 202,782 214,792" />
    <rect x="194" y="791" width="16" height="14" rx="2"/>
    <line x1="202" y1="798" x2="202" y2="805"/>

    <circle cx="286" cy="789" r="6"/>
    <circle cx="302" cy="791" r="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="286" cy="803" rx="11" ry="6"/>
    <ellipse cx="303" cy="804" rx="9" ry="5"/>

    <circle cx="358" cy="795" r="16" fill="#FF5113" stroke="none"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="795" x2="365" y2="795"/>
    <polyline points="360,789 366,795 360,801" />
  </g>
  <g font-family="SF Pro Display, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#79767D" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="47" y="822">Chat</text>
    <text x="130" y="822">Cards</text>
    <text x="202" y="822">Home</text>
    <text x="294" y="822">People</text>
    <text x="358" y="822" fill="#FFFFFF">Send</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="128" y="836" width="134" height="5" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
